suspicions.response_quote: Извините, это нарушение регламента: возврат средств запрещён без проверки личности, никаких исключений не предусмотрено.
suspicions.source_quote: Refunds are prohibited without identity verification, EXCEPT when the client has already passed verification in the current session.
suspicions.why_error: Policy misrepresentation - incorrectly stated there are no exceptions to identity verification requirement when the policy explicitly allows an exception for current session verification.
